name: COUCH MULTIPLAYER
description: Play side by side on one PC. Set PLAYERS to 2 and load your save: this window becomes player 1, starts the others with their own saves and controllers, and tiles them. Each player sees the others walking around their own world. Nothing is shared -- separate saves, parties and progress -- and you cannot block or interact with each other. PLAYERS 1 is the default and does nothing at all: no extra window, no controller filtering, no socket. Also binds the display hotkeys to the pad buttons the engine leaves free, gives each window its own music and sound-effect volume, and shows the address on screen so somebody on another PC can join without hunting for it. Install POKEMON FOLLOWERS alongside and every player gets their lead Pokemon hovering behind them.
